name: large-scale
description: Generic high-cost synthetic scaling scout over rounded analysis-unit dimensions.
limitations: The benchmark generator writes dense TSV inputs in bounded gene blocks because SPATHI consumes the ANDREA-compatible dense input contract. These cases measure a conservative synthetic envelope, not sparse H5 ingestion.
The dimensions are independently declared, deliberately rounded engineering workloads. They are not measurements or projections of any private biological dataset.
Only eight targets, ten trees per model, and twenty PCA components are used. Target-count and estimator-count extrapolations must be derived from the progressive profile and validated separately.
Groups are balanced synthetic populations and therefore do not model biological class imbalance.
Run this profile only after the progressive scout succeeds; the largest dense synthetic expression TSV can approach two gigabytes and require several gigabytes of transient memory.

cases.description: Rounded small one-group workload: 500 cells x 15,000 genes x 1,000 TFs.
Rounded medium two-group workload: 1,500 cells x 18,000 genes x 1,000 TFs.
Rounded wide workload: 5,000 cells x 25,000 genes x 1,500 TFs x three groups.
Rounded high-cell workload: 10,000 cells x 20,000 genes x 1,200 TFs x three groups.
